message.content:
A cell that contains more than one nucleus is called a **multinucleated (or polynuclear) cell**.  
Examples include:

| Cell type | Typical function | Where you find it |
|-----------|-----------------|-------------------|
| **Multinucleated giant cells** | Immune response, wall off foreign material | Granulomatous inflammation (e.g., tuberculosis, sarcoidosis) |
| **Skeletal muscle fibers** | Contractile muscle | Skeletal muscle tissue |
| **Osteoclasts** | Bone resorption | Bone remodeling sites |
| **Syncytium** (e.g., placenta, certain viral infections) | Specialized fusion of cells | Placental villi, syncytial trophoblasts |

So, the general term you’re looking for is **multinucleated cell**.
